elevenlabs.commission: 22% of payments for 12 months (Starter/Creator/Pro/Scale), 11% on Business, Enterprise excluded
elevenlabs.notes: Commission payable 90 days after referral's first payment; $5 minimum. No placement bans found on public page; check PartnerStack terms.

higgsfield.commission: Up to 25% of plan price, recurring up to 12 months (tiered by revenue; older ambassador page said 15%)
higgsfield.notes: Terms forbid paid advertising, brand-name bidding, and coupon/cashback sites. Referrals get up to 50% off for 3 hours after landing.

n8n.commission: 30% of n8n Cloud revenue for the first 12 months
n8n.notes: Paid ad campaigns prohibited. PayPal only, EUR 100 minimum. Self-hosted guides earn nothing; link to Cloud signup.

runway.commission: $15 flat per new paid subscriber via unique code, uncapped; followers get 25% off
runway.notes: Code-based, social-first. Fits the dejaviewed Instagram account better than the website. Active partners get a free Max plan. Don't confuse with Runway Catalog on Awin (different company).

lovable.commission: Up to $100 per first-time subscriber, tiered bonuses (docs page separately mentions 20% of first 12 payments)
lovable.notes: Two official pages disagree on structure; confirm in Impact.

official_check.note: 403 is a bot wall on scripted requests; domain is the vendor's real site (checked in research source_url)

framer.commission: 50% of subscription payments for first 12 months
framer.notes: Tracking via Dub; Stripe payout, $200 minimum. Bans coupon/cashback sites, Framer-term search bidding, search-ad placement, spam. Existing Framer users don't attribute.

webflow.commission: 50% of first Site/Workspace subscription for up to 12 months (higher tiers add 10-15% renewal bonus)
webflow.notes: No commissions on client referrals or self-purchases.

raycast.commission: 30% of payments from referred Raycast Pro users; referees get 10% off
raycast.notes: Duration not stated. Payout via Wise above GBP 50, 30-day pending.

coursera.commission: 15%-45% on eligible purchases; Coursera Plus pays first month only; degrees excluded
coursera.notes: Good fit for 'learn X' guide pages.

tradingview.commission: Flat one-time per new subscriber: monthly $10-$200, annual $60-$400 by plan (older rules page cited 30% recurring)
tradingview.notes: Prohibits brand-keyword bidding and unsolicited messaging. Web purchases only. PayPal monthly.

manus.commission: 10% of referred subscription payments for up to 365 days; followers get 1,000 bonus credits
manus.notes: Runs on Tapfiliate. $100 PayPal minimum. Enterprise and add-ons excluded.

descript.commission: $25 flat per new subscriber (older terms were 15% recurring year one)
descript.notes: Program migrating to PartnerStack; existing affiliates must reapply.

kling.commission: unknown (a coupon site claims up to 30%)
kling.notes: Impact listing exists but terms unverified. Separate Kling Creative Partners Program is application-based for filmmakers/artists.

runpod.commission: Referral: 3% of Pod / 5% of Serverless spend for referee's first 6 months, in credits. Affiliate tier: 10% cash after 25 paying referrals.
runpod.notes: Small site starts on credits-only referral.

vast-ai.commission: 3% of referee spend for life of their account; 75% cashable
vast-ai.notes: Cash-out via Stripe Connect, PayPal or Wise.

perplexity.commission: Comet browser referral paid $2-$20 per install depending on country/date (late 2025); 2026 status unknown
perplexity.notes: Cash referral is for the Comet browser install. No formal affiliate. Publishers' Program is ad revenue share for news outlets, not applicable.

official_check.note: 403 is a bot wall on scripted requests; domain is the vendor's real site (checked in research source_url)

vercel.commission: Reported $5 per lead + 30% recurring for 6 months (v0 Ambassador Program)
vercel.notes: v0 Ambassador program; terms reported, not verified. Official terms page confirms the program exists; rates only from third parties. Signup URL not found.

warp.commission: Swag/gift-card tiers ($0 at 1 referral up to ~$100 at 100)

setapp.commission: $25 flat per new paid member (older page said $11.50 per trial)

skillshare.commission: 20% of first payment, capped at $34 per new customer (older page said 40%/$67)

official_check.note: 403 is a bot wall on scripted requests; domain is the vendor's real site (checked in research source_url)

udemy.commission: 10% baseline; an Involve Asia listing shows 7% after July 2026

official_check.note: 403 is a bot wall on scripted requests; domain is the vendor's real site (checked in research source_url)

amazon.commission: Category rates; physical books ~4.5%, electronics ~1-3% (third-party figures)
amazon.notes: Rates from third-party guides; check Associates fee schedule. Low payout but universal for books/hardware.

hostinger.commission: 40% base, up to 60% by volume, one-time per sale (sources conflict)
hostinger.notes: Official terms page not retrieved. Weak relevance to catalog.

blender.commission: Blender itself: none (free, open source). Superhive (formerly Blender Market) add-on marketplace has an affiliate system; rate set per creator, commonly 5-10%.
blender.notes: Program is Superhive (ex-Blender Market) marketplace, not Blender itself; only link Superhive products, never point Blender pills at it. Only route to monetize Blender content is linking specific paid add-ons on Superhive; rates vary per product.

notion.commission: Up to $50 per activated signup + 20% of year-one revenue
notion.notes: Closed to new affiliates. Cannot join now. Recheck later.

polymarket.commission: Reported 10% of net fees from direct referrals, 5% indirect (third-party, unverified)
polymarket.notes: Skip: wagering-adjacent, jurisdiction-restricted, US program gated via CFTC rules. RECOMMEND SKIP. Prediction-market/wagering promotion carries jurisdiction restrictions (offers 'not available in all jurisdictions'), US eligibility is gated through CFTC-filed rules, and promoting it alongside trading content creates gambling-adjacent and FTC risk for a small site.
